data.title: Data & Privacy
data.subtitle: Export your organization's data or delete your account.

export.title: Export Data
export.description: You can request a complete export of your organization's data. This includes all processing activities, vendor assessments, DSAR records, breaches, and uploaded documents.
export.email_notice: A zip file will be sent to your email when ready.
export.success: Export requested successfully! You will receive an email when it is ready.
export.error: Failed to request data export. Please try again later.

retention.title: Data Retention Policy
retention.active: retained as long as your account is active
retention.consent: retained for 5 years after collection (regulatory requirement)
retention.audit: retained for 3 years after the event
retention.deleted: permanently removed 30 days after deletion request

deletion.title: Danger Zone
deletion.description: Permanently delete this organization and all of its data. This action cannot be undone. Data will be hard-deleted after a 30-day grace period.
deletion.error: Failed to schedule organization for deletion.
deletion.confirm_description: This permanently deletes all data after a 30-day grace period.

sso.title: Single Sign-On (SSO)
sso.subtitle: Configure SAML or OIDC single sign-on for your organisation.
sso.gate_description: We support SAML 2.0 and OIDC with Okta, Azure AD and Google Workspace. Connections are configured with you rather than self-serve, so the metadata exchange and the first login are verified before password login is disabled for your organisation.
sso.connection_note: These are the details we will ask for. They cannot be saved from here yet.
sso.enforce_description: Require all members to use SSO. Password login will be disabled. Enabled once a connection is live.
sso.enforce_aria: Enforce SSO (unavailable until a connection is configured)

siem.title: SIEM Integration
siem.subtitle: Stream audit logs to your security tool (Splunk, Datadog, Microsoft Sentinel) in real time.
siem.enable_description: When enabled, audit logs will be pushed to the configured endpoint.

residency.title: Data Residency
residency.subtitle: Control where your data is physically stored and processed.
residency.gate_description: Dedicated data residency is available on the Enterprise plan. Your data is currently stored securely in AWS Dublin (eu-west-1) in a multi-tenant environment.
residency.change_region_description: Select a new region to provision a dedicated database and migrate your data.
residency.warning: Important: changing your region will provision a new dedicated PostgreSQL instance in {region}. Your existing data will be migrated, which can take several minutes. Your organisation will be placed in read-only mode during this time.
residency.confirm_description: The migration takes 15–30 minutes. Your organisation is placed in read-only mode for the whole of it, so nobody can record a breach or respond to a DSAR until it finishes.
residency.infra_2: Encrypted at rest using AWS KMS.
residency.infra_3: Automated daily backups retained for 7 days.
residency.infra_4: Documents and attachments stored in regional S3 buckets.

roles.title: Custom Roles
roles.subtitle: Configure granular permissions for your team members.
roles.name: Role Name
roles.delete_description: Everyone currently holding this role loses its permissions immediately and falls back to their default access.
